steps.text: Throughout the app, some fields or columns display an ⓘ icon. This signals that extra information is available — just click it to read the explanation.
steps.title: Spot the ⓘ icon

steps.text: Click the ⓘ icon to get more information about that field. A popover appears with the title and full description.
steps.title: Click ⓘ for details

steps.text: The popover shows the field name and its full explanation, letting you understand what each value means without leaving the page. The ⓘ icon works the same way wherever you see it in the app.
steps.title: Popover appears
